sources.cite: Google Cloud, Associate Cloud Engineer exam guide (PDF linked from the certification page): setting up a cloud solution environment (~20%), planning and implementing a cloud solution (~30%), ensuring the successful operation of a cloud solution (~30%), configuring access and security (~20%)
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-18. Four sections with the weights above match the course seed's units; subsections 3.3 'Managing networking resources' and 4.2 'Managing service accounts'; the guide names CMEK (3.2), Query Insights (3.4) and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (2.1, 3.1). The HTML page at cloud.google.com/certification/guides/cloud-engineer/ still shows an older five-section outline (Cloud Functions, Cloud Run for Anthos); the PDF is the current guide.

sources.cite: Google Cloud documentation, Cloud KMS: Key version states
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Relevant text: a version scheduled for destruction 'can't be used for cryptographic operations' and 'can be restored to disabled during the scheduled period' (default 30 days); disabled versions keep their key material and can be re-enabled; destroyed material is removed and 'Ciphertext encrypted with a destroyed version can't be recovered'; decryption works with any enabled version. The 'Destroy and restore key versions' page (read 2026-11-18): 'After a key is destroyed, data that was encrypted with the key version can't be decrypted'; versions wait 30 days by default in scheduled-for-destruction and can be restored during that time; check key usage tracking before destroying ('can be delayed or incomplete'). That BigQuery tables written before a rotation still use the older version follows from that, stated as the author's; the error wording is an authored rendering.
